methodology: Collect -> Measure -> Map -> Generate -> Mutate -> Critique -> Encode -> Repeat

laws.title: Strict Anti-Generic Geometry
laws.rule: 0px border-radius everywhere. 1px solid crisp borders (#1E293B). 4px x 4px 90-degree corner brackets on specimen cards.

laws.title: Data-Driven Color Semantics
laws.rule: Color is purposeful telemetry: Phosphor Green (#25E86E) for normal operations, Signal Red (#FF2A42) for alert/defect states, Phosphor Amber (#FFB000) for warnings, Phosphor Cyan (#00F0FF) for coordinates and vector headers.

laws.title: Deterministic Mutation & Lineage
laws.rule: Every generative state must be reproducible from a hex seed (e.g. 0x4A2F8B) and hot-mutatable via normalized parameters.

laws.title: GPU & Battery Discipline
laws.rule: DPR clamped to Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2.0). Canvases outside the viewport MUST pause animation loops immediately via IntersectionObserver.

forbidden_moves: NO generic cyberpunk neon purple or pink gradients.
NO glassmorphism, blur-behind, or frosted translucency gimmicks.
NO random decorative terminal fake ASCII nonsense.
NO rounded pill buttons or smooth bubble tags.
NO un-throttled continuous canvas loops when off-screen.
